prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Save Your New Pet", "Sign in now to safely sync your newly adopted companion to your cloud account."]
1: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select a buddy to live and play on your desktop.", "Interactive & Reactive"]
2: ["Essential Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact with, move, or hide your desktop pet anytime.", "Right-click pet for Quick Menu & Hide option", "Click and drag to reposition anywhere on screen"]
3: ["Photo Upload Best Practices", "Use well-lit, front-facing photos for optimal pet generation quality.", "Clear front-facing photos yield the best pet rendering results."]
4: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all saved pets and cloud progress."]
5: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop", "Generating pet animations and setting up desktop hooks..."]
6: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Choose a ready-to-go companion or build a custom pet from your photo."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Desktop!", "Look at your desktop corner or system tray to start interacting with your pet."]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new companion is officially registered and securely saved to your account.", "Welcome Pet Home"]
9: ["You can always adopt additional pets or try custom creation later from settings."]
